findings: Protocol ancestry is nonconforming and is judged separately from behavior. The account commit is mechanically an ancestor of the implementation commit, but account.json candidly records that the production implementation already existed as uncommitted work when the three-commit protocol became active. This review preserves that grandfathered-work-in-progress fact and does not treat the commit ordering as historical account-before-code evidence.

Java CucaDiagram.currentTogether inspects only the top stack item. gotoGroup pushes an Entity, so a Together opened inside that package receives no parent from an outer Together. Rust ClassParser::try_together instead scans backward across ClassScope::Package entries and can assign the outer Together as parent. This directly contradicts Java stack semantics and the account's claimed nesting model.

Java CucaDiagram.reallyCreateLeaf assigns currentTogether to every newly created leaf, including leaves first created by CommandLinkClass. Rust assigns Together membership only in try_entity_decl after an explicit declaration; create_entity_at_path and ensure_entity do not enroll implicit relationship endpoints. The relationship-only probe happens to pass, but implicit_explicit_mixed_together_members fails once implicit and explicit members share the same scope.

Java Cluster.printCluster2 emits ordinary nodes before root Together subgraphs, and printTogether emits direct leaves, direct child clusters, then child Together scopes. Rust build_together_trees creates the entire nested subgraph tree before grouped nodes exist, creates grouped nodes afterward, and builds visible child clusters later. The implementation therefore does not reproduce the cited Java statement order even though the three top-level standalone matrices happen to solve identically.

The SquareMaker and Magma phase-order portion survives the held-outs. The 3, 4, and 5 standalone matrices all match exactly after generated links are appended behind user relationships, covering both perfect-square and non-square branch shapes, changed labels, nested scopes, and declaration-order variation.

The invisible-versus-painted canvas adjustment survives the three top-level Together matrices, whose complete SVG structures and canvas dimensions match Java. It is not sufficient for package-owned cases: package_owned_together_children_lr differs at 592x612 expected versus 809x429 actual, and the package-crossing scope case differs at 542x450 expected versus 520x318 actual.

Package controls show mixed causality. package_children_lr_without_together_control also fails, so the package-heavy divergence is not solely attributable to Together. However package_inner_together_without_outer_control and outer_together_package_no_inner_control also fail, so package ownership and node/cluster emission remain behaviorally unvalidated for this mechanism. All controls remain executable rather than being excluded as unrelated.

The sibling redeclaration probe exposes release-only behavior introduced by the new ordering code. The same node is enrolled in two Together groups, graphviz_node_creation_order produces four entries for three nodes, and the debug build panics at the new debug_assert_eq with left 4 and right 3 before falling back to a grid. Release compiles the assertion away and emits a different incorrect SVG. Java retains the entity's first Together identity. The changed display-label mismatch is older parser behavior, but the duplicate-membership assertion and release divergence are specific to this mechanism.

Static searches found no new production golden reads, fixture-label branches, coordinate-keyed SVG surgery, comparator edits, or changed layout thresholds. Fresh names occur only in unit tests. The only new numeric layout expression is the standard 0.0 versus f64::INFINITY fold identity used for painted bounds; no new high-precision parity constant was introduced.

All 12 fresh Java SVGs are well-formed CLASS diagrams with entity groups and no recognized PlantUML error-page markers. Their source hashes are mutually unique and do not duplicate any of the 12,876 golden or perturbation sources examined after generation.
